notes: «وحدثنا» starts a second isnad carrying the same saying (Ali's sermon): two groups, each writing its names in full, so the tail is null (rule 4)
«عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم» is one link with the name alone (rule 7); «عن أبيه» is a bare relation
Ali is named in the story and his words are the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6); «عند أمير المؤمنين» is a place, not a link. Not flagged for ruling
«رضي الله عنه» and «عليه السلام» are left out
